title: Compatible additive equivalences on directed Hom systems
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty directed partially ordered set, and let $(A_i,u_{ij})$ and $(B_i,v_{ij})$ be two directed systems of abelian groups indexed by $I$, with direct limits and canonical maps $\iota_i^A,\iota_i^B$ as in [def-weil-directed-colimit-abelian-groups]. Suppose $e_i:A_i\xrightarrow{\sim}B_i$ are additive equivalences such that $e_j\circ u_{ij}=v_{ij}\circ e_i$ for every $i\leq j$. Then there is an additive equivalence
$$e:\varinjlim_{i\in I}A_i\xrightarrow{\sim}\varinjlim_{i\in I}B_i$$
with $e(\iota_i^A(x))=\iota_i^B(e_i(x))$ and $e^{-1}(\iota_i^B(y))=\iota_i^A(e_i^{-1}(y))$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: apply AddCommGroup.DirectLimit.congr (line 417) to the abelian groups A_i, B_i and the additive equivalences e_i with their stated compatibility. It is stated for additive commutative monoids over any preorder, hence includes this case. The representative formulas are AddCommGroup.DirectLimit.congr_apply_of (line 429) and AddCommGroup.DirectLimit.congr_symm_apply_of (line 437) in the same file. Classical decidable equality on I discharges its DecidableEq parameter. The direct-sum congruence quotient is the direct-limit presentation specified in the definition node.
